title: Step's First Large Model Native Intelligent Device Smartphone Is Scheduled: One Sentence to Arrange Errands, Take a Poster and Help You Apply for Leave
summary: Step Terminal announced that its first large model native intelligent device smartphone, STEPX Neo, will be released on October 13th at 7:00 PM. The device is equipped with the Step AOS intelligent device native operating system and has passed the initial L3-level test of the national standard for artificial intelligence terminal intelligence classification. Unlike traditional smartphones where AI is an accessory, it emphasizes the deep integration of large models with software and hardware. It includes the Step Amoo intelligent agent, highlighting the concept that the phone can work on its own.
